docs.title: ARPatent Web Platform Documentation
docs.text:
The web platform is the backend behind ARPatent: it registers 3D design submissions, drives the 3D Model Converter and the image-to-3D generator, runs an expert review workflow, and serves the finished models to the Unity AR client.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: The platform runs as a small set of cooperating containers. The API process serves HTTP and never blocks on heavy work; everything slow (conversion, thumbnailing, image generation) is pushed to Celery workers over Redis. State lives in PostgreSQL, and binary artifacts live on a shared media volume.

docs.title: Service topology
docs.text:
graph TD
    subgraph client[Clients]
        B[Browser / React SPA]
        AR[Unity AR client]
    end

    B -->|HTTPS| API[FastAPI api<br/>uvicorn]
    AR -->|HTTPS + media token| API

    API -->|async asyncpg| PG[(PostgreSQL)]
    API -->|enqueue| R[(Redis broker)]
    API -->|read/write artifacts| MV[[media volume]]

    R --> W[Celery worker<br/>queue: celery]
    R --> G[Celery generator<br/>queue: generate]

    W -->|sync psycopg2| PG
    G -->|sync psycopg2| PG
    W --> MV
    G --> MV

    W -->|docker API| SP[docker-socket-proxy]
    SP -->|spawn ephemeral| CONV[youndria/arpatent<br/>converter + thumbnailer]
    G -->|HTTP| HY[host-native<br/>Hunyuan3D API]

    W -. docker cp in/out .-> CONV
  • api — FastAPI under Uvicorn (dev) / Gunicorn (prod). Async end to end: asyncpg to Postgres, non-blocking request handling. Enqueues Celery tasks but never runs them.
  • worker — Celery worker on the default celery queue (--concurrency=1). Runs convert_patent_task and generate_thumbnail_task, which drive the ephemeral converter containers via Docker-out-of-Docker (DooD).
  • generator — a second Celery worker bound to the generate queue (--concurrency=1). Isolated because Hunyuan3D needs a GPU and serializes to a single in-flight request.
  • socket-proxy — tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy, the only thing with access to the Docker socket. The worker talks to it (DOCKER_HOST=tcp://socket-proxy:2375) so a compromised worker can't reach the full host daemon directly.
  • db / redis — PostgreSQL 15 and Redis 7.

The converter container is not mounted

The ephemeral youndria/arpatent containers run with --network none, --cap-drop ALL, --security-opt no-new-privileges, and no volume mounts. The worker streams the input ZIP in and the GLB / warning JSONs out with docker cp, so the job is fully isolated from the host filesystem and network. See app.worker.tasks.

docs.title: Two database sessions, by design
docs.text:
FastAPI is async and Celery is sync, so there are two SQLAlchemy engines against the same database:

graph LR
    subgraph asyncside[FastAPI request path]
        AR2[route] --> AS[get_db<br/>AsyncSession] --> AE[asyncpg engine]
    end
    subgraph syncside[Celery task path]
        CT[task] --> SS[SyncSessionLocal<br/>Session] --> SE[psycopg2 engine]
    end
    AE --> DB[(PostgreSQL)]
    SE --> DB
  • Routes depend on get_db which yields an AsyncSession (app.db.session).
  • Tasks open a SyncSessionLocal (app.db.sync_session) directly — they are plain functions running in a worker process, not in the event loop.

Both URLs are derived from one settings object — see Settings.database_url / Settings.sync_database_url.

docs.title: Code layers
docs.text:
The app/ package is organised by responsibility. Dependencies point downward; nothing in a lower layer imports an upper one.

graph TD
    main[app.main<br/>FastAPI app + CORS + routers] --> routes
    routes[app.api.routes<br/>auth · patents · locarno · admin · expert] --> deps[app.api.deps<br/>auth gates]
    routes --> schemas[app.schemas<br/>Pydantic DTOs]
    routes --> core[app.core<br/>security · upload validation · config]
    routes --> data[app.data.locarno<br/>read helpers]
    routes --> models
    routes -->|enqueue| worker[app.worker.tasks<br/>Celery tasks]
    worker --> models
    worker --> core
    deps --> models[app.models<br/>SQLAlchemy ORM]
    data --> models
    models --> base[app.db.base / session / sync_session]
Layer Package Responsibility Entrypoint app.main Builds the FastAPI app, adds CORS, mounts routers under /api, exposes /health. Routes app.api.routes HTTP endpoints, grouped by feature. Admin and expert routers gate every sub-route at the package level. Dependencies app.api.deps get_current_user and the role gates (*_admin_user, *_expert_user, get_optional_user). Schemas app.schemas Pydantic request/response models. Response models never leak password hashes or hidden review state. Core app.core Settings, JWT + password + media-token helpers, ZIP and image upload validation. Models app.models SQLAlchemy ORM entities and the derived review-state logic. Data app.data.locarno Thin read helpers over the Locarno lookup tables. Workers app.worker Celery app config and the conversion / thumbnail / generation tasks.

docs.title: Data model
docs.text:
classDiagram
    class User {
        +int id
        +str username
        +str email
        +str password
        +UserRole role
        +bool is_active
    }
    class Patent {
        +int id
        +int user_id
        +FileType file_type
        +str model_filename
        +str locarno_main_class
        +str locarno_subclass
        +ModelScale scale
        +ConversionStatus conversion_status
        +JSON related_files
        +JSON conversion_warnings
    }
    class DesignReview {
        +int id
        +int patent_id
        +ReviewDecision status
        +str rejection_reason
        +int reviewed_by
        +datetime submitted_at
        +datetime decided_at
    }
    class LocarnoMainClassRow {
        +str value PK
        +int number
        +str label
    }
    class LocarnoSubclassRow {
        +str value PK
        +str main_class_value FK
        +str label
    }

    User "1" --> "0..*" Patent : owns
    Patent "1" --> "0..*" DesignReview : review cycles
    User "1" --> "0..*" DesignReview : reviewed_by
    LocarnoMainClassRow "1" --> "0..*" LocarnoSubclassRow : subclasses

Two modelling decisions are worth calling out:

  • Review state is derived, not stored. A Patent has no status column for moderation. Each submit/decision cycle is a DesignReview row, and the effective state (DRAFT / UNDER_REVIEW / APPROVED / REJECTED) is computed from those rows by effective_review_state. This keeps the full audit trail (every reject + resubmit) and keeps lifecycle fields off the core entity.
  • Locarno classification is referenced by string, not foreign key. A Patent stores the Locarno value strings directly. The lookup tables hold the canonical hierarchy (5000+ subclasses — too many for a native enum), and the admin Locarno routes enforce referential integrity in application code before any delete. See app.api.routes.admin Locarno management.

docs.title: Web Platform Backend
docs.text:
The backend is a FastAPI application backed by PostgreSQL, with background work handled by Celery workers over a Redis broker. It is the hub of the ARPatent system: users register a 3D design (by uploading a model archive or by generating one from reference photos), the design is converted to a compressed GLB, an expert reviews it, and approved designs become publicly browseable and viewable in AR.

It owns three responsibilities the rest of the system depends on:

  • Ingestion & conversion — accept an upload or an image set, validate it, and drive it through the converter / generator pipelines to a final GLB plus a PNG thumbnail.
  • Moderation — a strict design-review lifecycle (draft, under review, approved, rejected) that decides what becomes public.
  • Serving — authenticated and capability-token access to models, thumbnails, and source images, including the QR-link flow that lets the AR client open a not-yet-public design.

docs.title: Ingestion paths
docs.text:
A design enters the platform through one of two paths, and both converge on the same converter so there is a single GLB post-processing pipeline.

Path Endpoint Source Engine ZIP upload POST /api/patents/upload A .zip with exactly one model file (.obj/.stl/.stp/.iges/.glb/.fbx) 3D Model Converter container Image-to-3D POST /api/patents/generate 1-4 reference photos (front/left/right/back) Host-native Hunyuan3D, then the converter

Why image generation still goes through the converter

Hunyuan3D's GLB is not the finished product: it still needs the converter's Blender import to DRACO re-export step. Rather than duplicate that container plumbing, the generator wraps the raw GLB in a ZIP and hands it to the very same convert_patent_task as a GLB upload. Both ingestion paths therefore share one conversion and one thumbnail step. See Request & worker flows.

docs.text: Concern Technology HTTP API FastAPI 0.115 (async), Uvicorn / Gunicorn Database PostgreSQL 15 via SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async asyncpg for the API, sync psycopg2 for workers) Migrations Alembic Background jobs Celery 5.4 with a Redis 7 broker + result backend Auth JWT (python-jose) access/refresh tokens + bcrypt password hashing (passlib) Upload safety python-magic (MIME), Pillow (image re-encode), a zip-bomb detector 3D conversion The youndria/arpatent converter image, spawned per job via Docker-out-of-Docker Image-to-3D Host-native Hunyuan3D-2 API server

docs.title: Roles
docs.text:
Authorization is driven by a single UserRole enum — see app.models.user.

Role Can USER Register, manage, and submit their own designs; browse approved designs. EXPERT Everything a viewer can, plus evaluate (approve/reject) submissions. No admin panel. ADMIN Run the admin panel (users, designs, the Locarno tree). Cannot evaluate submissions.

EXPERT and ADMIN are intentionally disjoint capabilities. See the expert evaluation workflow.

docs.title: Deployment
docs.text:
The platform ships as a Docker Compose stack. There are two compose files, kept isolated by Compose project name so dev and prod have independent databases and media volumes:

Environment Compose file Project name Development docker-compose.yml arpatent Production docker-compose.prod.yml arpatent-prod

The README is the canonical runbook

fastapi_app/README.md holds the full, step-by-step operational guide (first-time setup, ngrok exposure, versioned deploys, rollbacks, TLS). This page is the architectural summary. Every command assumes you are inside fastapi_app/.

docs.title: Services
docs.text:
Both compose files describe the same logical services (prod adds nginx, a frontend builder, and certbot):

Service Image Role db postgres:15 Application database redis redis:7-alpine Celery broker + result backend api built from Dockerfile FastAPI (uvicorn in dev, gunicorn + 4 uvicorn workers in prod) worker same image as api Celery worker, default queue (conversion + thumbnail) generator same image as api Celery worker, generate queue (Hunyuan3D) socket-proxy tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy Mediates the worker's Docker API calls nginx (prod) nginx:alpine TLS-terminated reverse proxy + static SPA frontend-builder (prod) built from frontend/Dockerfile One-shot React build into a shared volume certbot (prod) certbot/certbot Dormant unless serving a real domain

The api, worker, and generator share one image and the media_data volume. The worker additionally joins the internal proxy-net to reach the socket proxy; the generator gets a host.docker.internal host-gateway alias to reach the host-native Hunyuan3D server.

The converter image is external

The worker spawns youndria/arpatent containers as siblings; that image is not built from this repo. Pull it on the host first: 

docker pull youndria/arpatent:1.5
The exact tag is pinned in CONVERTER_IMAGE in app.worker.celery_app — bump it in one place.

docs.title: The application image
docs.text:
Dockerfile builds a single python:3.11-slim image used by the api and both workers. It installs the Docker CLI (a no-op in the api container, used by the worker for DooD) and libmagic1 (for upload MIME sniffing), then runs as an unprivileged app user (UID 1000).

docker build -t arpatent-api:v0.1.0 .   # tag must match APP_VERSION in .env

docs.title: Development quickstart
docs.text:
docker-compose.yml bind-mounts the source for hot reload and hardcodes local credentials.

cd fastapi_app
docker compose up --build           # db, redis, api, worker, generator, socket-proxy
docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
  • API: http://localhost:8000 — interactive docs at /docs
  • Run the React frontend separately with Vite (cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev).

docs.title: Production overview
docs.text:
docker-compose.prod.yml pins images by APP_VERSION, runs gunicorn with 4 workers behind nginx, sets per-service mem_limit / pids_limit, and caps container logs. The high-level sequence (see the README for the detail):

cp .env.example .env                 # set POSTGRES_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET_KEY, CORS_ORIGINS, APP_VERSION
docker pull youndria/arpatent:1.5
docker build -t arpatent-api:v0.1.0 .
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm api alembic upgrade head
ngrok http 80                        # public TLS edge

Never down -v in production

The -v flag deletes the named volumes — the Postgres database and every uploaded model. It is a dev-only reset button.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: All runtime config is environment-driven through app.core.config.Settings, loaded from .env. Required secrets have no default and must be supplied: POSTGRES_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET_KEY. See .env.example for the full set.

docs.title: Migrations
docs.text:
Alembic migrations are a deliberate step, never run automatically on container start, so a failed migration aborts the release before traffic shifts.

# dev
docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
# prod (disposable one-shot container)
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm api alembic upgrade head

Autogenerate misses column renames, check constraints, Postgres enum value additions (write op.execute("ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE ...") by hand), and data backfills — review every generated revision. Full rules in the README.

docs.title: Bootstrapping the first admin
docs.text:
There is no HTTP route to self-promote. The first admin is created out-of-band with a management command that ships inside the image (app.scripts.set_admin):

docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api python -m app.scripts.set_admin <username>

The user must already exist (register first) and must re-login for the new role to take effect. After that, role changes go through PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}. The command refuses to demote or remove the last active admin.

docs.title: Request & worker flows
docs.text: This page traces a design from ingestion to public visibility. Endpoints are mounted under /api (see app.main); the route modules themselves are in app.api.routes.

docs.title: Conversion status state machine
docs.text:
Every Patent carries a ConversionStatus. The two ingestion paths share the tail of the pipeline.

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> UPLOADED: POST /patents/upload
    [*] --> QUEUED: POST /patents/generate

    UPLOADED --> QUEUED: POST /{id}/convert
    QUEUED --> GENERATING: generator picks up (image-gen only)
    GENERATING --> QUEUED: GLB wrapped, handed to convert queue
    QUEUED --> CONVERTING: worker picks up
    CONVERTING --> CONVERTED: GLB written, thumbnail attempted
    CONVERTING --> FAILED: converter error
    GENERATING --> FAILED: Hunyuan error
    FAILED --> QUEUED: POST /{id}/convert (retry)
  • UPLOADED — ZIP stored, conversion is user-triggered.
  • QUEUED — a Celery task is enqueued and waiting for a worker.
  • GENERATING — the generator is running Hunyuan3D (image-gen only).
  • CONVERTING — an ephemeral converter container is running.
  • CONVERTED — GLB ready; the thumbnail step flips this flag (best-effort).
  • FAILED — the last attempt failed; conversion_error holds the message.

See the enum in app.models.patent.

docs.title: ZIP upload → conversion
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as Client
    participant API as FastAPI
    participant DB as Postgres
    participant Q as Redis
    participant W as Celery worker
    participant C as Converter container

    U->>API: POST /patents/upload (zip + form)
    API->>API: validate_zip_upload (bomb/MIME/size/structure)
    API->>DB: INSERT patent (UPLOADED)
    API-->>U: 202 {patent_id, UPLOADED}

    U->>API: POST /patents/{id}/convert
    API->>DB: status = QUEUED
    API->>Q: convert_patent_task.delay(id)
    API-->>U: 202 {QUEUED}

    W->>Q: pick up task
    W->>DB: status = CONVERTING
    W->>C: docker create (network none, cap-drop all)
    W->>C: docker cp zip in
    W->>C: docker start (xvfb-run main.py)
    C-->>W: output.glb (+ optional *_errors.json)
    W->>W: docker cp glb out → media volume
    W->>DB: glb_file_path set, warnings saved
    W->>Q: generate_thumbnail_task.delay(id)
    W->>DB: status = CONVERTED (set by thumbnail task)

The upload is validated up front by validate_zip_upload: a zip-bomb scan (overlapping-records detector), symlink and path-traversal rejection, entry-count and uncompressed-size and compression-ratio caps, a single-model-file rule (.obj must ship exactly one .mtl), and a libmagic MIME whitelist on the model file itself.

The conversion task itself lives in convert_patent_task. Soft warnings emitted by the converter (import_errors.json / export_errors.json) are pulled out, tagged with a phase, and stored on Patent.conversion_warnings so the UI can show a ⚠ badge without failing an otherwise-successful conversion.

Upload, then convert

# 1. Register the design (multipart): model ZIP + classification + scale
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/patents/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@chair.zip" \
  -F "design_name=Ergonomic Chair" \
  -F "locarno_main_class=SINIF_6" \
  -F "locarno_subclass=SINIF_6_01" \
  -F "scale=MM"
# -> 202 {"patent_id": 42, "status": "UPLOADED", ...}

# 2. Trigger conversion
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/patents/42/convert \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# -> 202 {"patent_id": 42, "status": "QUEUED"}

# 3. Poll until CONVERTED (or FAILED)
curl http://localhost:8000/api/patents/42/status \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

docs.title: Image-to-3D generation
docs.text:
The generate path produces a GLB from reference photos, then rejoins the conversion pipeline above.

sequenceDiagram
    participant U as Client
    participant API as FastAPI
    participant G as Celery generator
    participant HY as Hunyuan3D (host)
    participant W as Celery worker

    U->>API: POST /patents/generate (1-4 images)
    API->>API: validate_and_reencode each view → PNG
    API->>API: INSERT patent (IMAGE, QUEUED); store views
    API->>G: generate_from_image_task.delay(id, overrides)
    API-->>U: 202 {QUEUED}

    G->>API: status = GENERATING
    G->>HY: POST /generate (multi-view base64)
    HY-->>G: GLB bytes
    G->>G: wrap GLB in a ZIP on the media volume
    G->>W: convert_patent_task.delay(id)  (status QUEUED)
    Note over W: identical convert + thumbnail path as an upload

Images are validated and re-encoded by validate_and_reencode (size and dimension caps, re-encode to PNG RGBA to strip EXIF/ICC). UI presets map to pipeline params: quality → num_inference_steps, detail → octree_resolution (see the QUALITY_PRESETS / DETAIL_PRESETS tables in app.api.routes.patents). The generation task is generate_from_image_task.

docs.title: Expert review lifecycle
docs.text:
Moderation state is derived from design_reviews rows, never stored on the patent. A design is public only once it has an APPROVED review.

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DRAFT: created / re-opened
    DRAFT --> UNDER_REVIEW: owner POST /{id}/submit
    REJECTED --> UNDER_REVIEW: owner edits & resubmits
    UNDER_REVIEW --> APPROVED: expert approve (public, terminal)
    UNDER_REVIEW --> REJECTED: expert reject (+reason)
    APPROVED --> [*]
State Who sees the design Owner can edit? DRAFT Owner (private preview), admins, experts Yes UNDER_REVIEW Admins, experts. Obscured even from the owner. No (locked) APPROVED Everyone (public catalog + anonymous QR scans) No (locked) REJECTED Owner (with the reason), admins, experts Yes — edit & resubmit

The state function and helpers are in app.models.review; the owner-facing transitions (submit, reupload, metadata PATCH) are in app.api.routes.patents and the expert decisions in app.api.routes.expert.

Expert approves a submission

# The shared queue of submissions awaiting evaluation
curl http://localhost:8000/api/expert/submissions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXPERT_TOKEN"

# Approve (design becomes public) ...
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/expert/submissions/42/approve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXPERT_TOKEN"

# ... or reject with a reason (re-opens for the owner)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/expert/submissions/42/reject \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXPERT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"reason": "Mesh has inverted normals on the seat."}'

docs.title: Media access and the QR capability token
docs.text:
Models, thumbnails, and source images are served by app.api.routes.patents. Access follows the review state via _can_view_media: APPROVED designs are public; otherwise only the owner (for DRAFT/REJECTED), experts, admins, or a holder of a valid media token may fetch them.

The media token is a short-lived, single-patent capability token minted by create_media_token and verified by verify_media_token. It is encoded into QR links so an unauthenticated AR scanner can open a not-yet-public design's model:

graph LR
    O[Owner opens detail page] -->|GET /patents/id| API
    API -->|mints model_token if CONVERTED| O
    O -->|builds QR with ?token=...| QR[QR code]
    QR -->|scan| AR[AR client]
    AR -->|GET /patents/id/model?token=...| API
    API -->|verify_media_token| GLB[(GLB stream)]

The token has a distinct scope and carries no sub, so a leaked media token cannot be used as a login and an access token cannot be used as a media token.

docs.title: Plugging into the 3DPatent-AR site
docs.text:
This doc set is a self-contained MkDocs project (fastapi_app/mkdocs.yml + fastapi_app/docs/) that mirrors the structure of the published 3DPatent-AR documentation: a Home page, a component section (Overview + Architecture), an mkdocstrings API Reference, and Deployment + Maintenance pages, all on Material for MkDocs.

There are two ways to publish it alongside the existing site. The converter docs and the Unity AR docs are already two independent doc sets stitched together at the top level, so the sub-site approach below matches the existing pattern.

docs.title: Option A — separate sub-site (recommended)
docs.text:
This is how unity-ar-docs/ is integrated today: a standalone build whose output is copied into the published site and linked from the home page.

  1. Build this project into static HTML: 
    cd fastapi_app
pip install -r docs-requirements.txt
mkdocs build            # outputs ./site
  2. Copy the output into the 3DPatent-AR site source (the converter/docs/ tree on the main-fbx branch) under a new folder, e.g. converter/docs/web-platform/, so it deploys as …/3DPatent-AR/web-platform/.
  3. Add a card to the site's home page (converter/docs/index.md) next to the existing Converter and Unity AR cards: 
    -   **Web Platform**

    FastAPI + Celery backend: ingestion, conversion, review workflow, and model serving.

    [View Docs](web-platform/index.html){ .md-button .md-button--primary }
  4. Re-run the site's own mkdocs build / mkdocs gh-deploy. The sub-site is shipped as static assets, so the main build needs none of the FastAPI dependencies.

docs.title: Option B — merge into the existing MkDocs project
docs.text:
Fold these pages into the converter's mkdocs.yml as one unified site.

  1. Copy fastapi_app/docs/* into the site's docs directory under a web-platform/ subfolder (rename index.md to avoid clashing with the site root).
  2. Add the nav block from fastapi_app/mkdocs.yml (everything under Web Platform, API Reference, Deployment, Maintenance) into the site's nav:, prefixing each path with web-platform/.
  3. Make the FastAPI source importable to mkdocstrings. Either vendor the app/ package next to the docs and add it to paths, or point at it: 
    plugins:
  - mkdocstrings:
      handlers:
        python:
          paths: ["path/to/fastapi_app"]
    mkdocstrings reads the source statically (Griffe), so the app's runtime dependencies (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, …) do not need to be installed — only the .py files must be reachable on paths.

Why Option A is simpler here

The converter docs live in the baris-yildiz/3DPatent-AR repo while the FastAPI source lives in this repo. Option A ships pre-rendered HTML, so the two repos stay decoupled — the site build never needs this repo's source. Option B gives a single search index and unified theme but couples the site build to this repo's app/ package.

docs.title: Conventions this project follows
docs.text:
So future pages stay consistent with the rest of the site:

  • Material for MkDocs with navigation.tabs + navigation.sections.
  • mkdocstrings (Google-style docstrings, show_source, separate_signature, docstring_section_style: table) for every API Reference page — one ::: directive per module.
  • Mermaid diagrams via pymdownx.superfences for data flow, state machines, and the data model.
  • Admonitions (!!! note, !!! warning, !!! danger, !!! example) and tables for structured detail.
  • Each narrative page ends with a Next steps list of cross-links.

docs.title: Maintenance notes
docs.text: This page documents intentional design decisions that look like bugs or omissions but are not. Read this before changing the related code.

docs.title: Review state is derived, never stored
docs.text:
Patent has no moderation status column. Each submit/decision cycle is a row in design_reviews, and the effective state is computed on read:

# app/models/review.py
def effective_review_state(reviews) -> ReviewState:
    if any(r.status == ReviewDecision.APPROVED for r in rows):
        return ReviewState.APPROVED          # terminal — wins outright
    latest = latest_review(rows)
    ...

This preserves the full audit trail (every reject + resubmit) and keeps lifecycle fields off the core entity. Do not add a denormalised status column to patents_patent; query the reviews and call effective_review_state. See app.models.review.

docs.title: Two database sessions are intentional
docs.text: FastAPI is async and Celery is sync, so there are two engines against one DB: app.db.session (AsyncSession, asyncpg) for routes and app.db.sync_session (Session, psycopg2) for tasks. A route must use the async session; a task must use the sync one. Mixing them deadlocks or crashes — async drivers cannot run in a worker's sync context and vice versa.

docs.title: is_staff / is_superuser are dormant
docs.text:
# app/models/user.py
role: Mapped[UserRole] = mapped_column(...)   # the real authorization gate
is_staff: Mapped[bool] = ...                  # inherited from the Django schema, unused
is_superuser: Mapped[bool] = ...              # unused

Authorization is the single role column (USER / ADMIN / EXPERT). The two boolean columns are inherited from the original Django schema and intentionally left in place (dropping them is a migration with no benefit). Never gate behaviour on them.

docs.title: EXPERT and ADMIN are disjoint
docs.text: The role gates in app.api.deps are strict and separate: get_current_admin_user requires exactly ADMIN, get_current_expert_user requires exactly EXPERT. An admin cannot evaluate submissions and an expert gets no admin panel. This is deliberate separation of duties, not an oversight — do not let one role fall through to the other.

docs.title: The media token has no sub and a distinct scope
docs.text:
# app/core/security.py
{"pid": patent_id, "scope": MEDIA_TOKEN_SCOPE, "exp": expire}

Media capability tokens (used by QR links) deliberately omit sub and carry a media scope, so a leaked media token can't be used as a login (get_current_user rejects it) and an access token can't be used as a media token (verify_media_token checks the scope). Keep these properties if you touch token minting. See app.core.security.

docs.title: Image generation reuses the converter pipeline
docs.text: Hunyuan3D's GLB is not the finished product — it still needs the converter's Blender → DRACO re-export. Rather than duplicate the container plumbing, generate_from_image_task wraps the raw GLB in a ZIP and hands it to convert_patent_task as if it were a GLB upload. So there is exactly one conversion path and one thumbnail step. Don't add a parallel post-processing path for generated models. See app.worker.tasks.

docs.title: Thumbnailing is best-effort
docs.text: generate_thumbnail_task runs once (max_retries=0) and its finally block flips the patent to CONVERTED whether or not the render succeeded. A missing thumbnail must never gate an otherwise-finished model; callers fall back when /thumbnail returns 404.

docs.title: Converter containers run with no mounts
docs.text: Each ephemeral converter/thumbnailer container is created with --network none, --cap-drop ALL, --security-opt no-new-privileges, and no volume mounts. Inputs go in and outputs come out via docker cp. Do not "simplify" this by bind -mounting the media volume into the converter — the isolation is the point. The shell scripts run inside the container take the only user-controlled values as positional $1/$2 args, never interpolated into the script text, so they're unreachable by shell injection.

docs.title: Do not drop the container PIDs limit below 512
docs.text:
# app/worker/tasks.py
CONTAINER_PIDS = "512"

The converter (Blender + FreeCAD + xvfb) spawns many threads/processes. A --pids-limit of 100 caused SIGABRT crashes in production. Keep it at 512 or above.

docs.title: CONVERTER_IMAGE is a single source of truth
docs.text: The image tag lives once, in app.worker.celery_app, shared by the task that spawns containers and the orphan sweeper. Bumping it in one place can't desync them — don't hardcode the tag in tasks.py.

docs.title: Orphan converter cleanup on worker start
docs.text: If the worker is SIGKILLed mid-task, its finally block can't docker rm -f the spawned container. A worker_process_init handler prunes leftover youndria/arpatent containers on every worker process start (boot and worker_max_tasks_per_child recycles). Safe with --concurrency=1: no other task is running when the signal fires.

docs.title: Crash safety: task_acks_late + worker recycling
docs.text: The Celery worker runs with task_acks_late=True (a task isn't acked until it finishes, so a crash redelivers it), worker_prefetch_multiplier=1, and worker_max_tasks_per_child=50 (recycle the process to bound fd/memory leaks from the subprocess + docker CLI shellouts). The 30s stop_grace_period in compose pairs with this.

docs.title: Locarno data is not memoized in-process
docs.text:
# app/data/locarno.py
def invalidate() -> None:
    return None   # no-op; reads go straight to the DB

Production runs multiple uvicorn workers plus Celery workers; a per-process cache can't be invalidated across them, so an admin edit in one worker would leave the others stale. The read helpers query the DB every call instead. invalidate() is kept as a no-op at every mutation site so intent stays explicit if memoization ever returns. See app.data.locarno.

docs.title: Locarno integrity is enforced in application code
docs.text: Designs reference Locarno entries by plain string (patents_patent.locarno_*), with no foreign key to the lookup tables (5000+ subclasses, validated at the app layer). So the admin Locarno routes count referencing designs and refuse a delete (409) if any exist — never orphan a design's classification. See app.api.routes.admin.

docs.title: Fuzzy search uses pg_trgm word_similarity
docs.text:
The catalog, expert queue, and admin list use Postgres pg_trgm word_similarity (not plain similarity) so long names aren't penalised for length, with a per-transaction threshold:

await db.execute(text("SET LOCAL pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold = 0.3"))
stmt = stmt.where(Patent.model_filename.op("%>")(q_clean))

SET LOCAL is transaction-scoped. The pg_trgm extension and a GIN index must exist (created by migration).

docs.title: Last-admin protection
docs.text: The admin user routes refuse to demote, deactivate, or delete the last active admin, and an admin cannot change their own role/active status. This guarantees the system can never be locked out of all admin access. See app.api.routes.admin.

def validate_and_reencode(content: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    """
    Validate a single image upload and return a normalised PNG byte string.

    Raises HTTPException on any validation failure.
    """
    if len(content) > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            detail=f"'{label}' exceeds {MAX_IMAGE_SIZE // (1024 * 1024)} MB limit",
        )

    try:
        probe = Image.open(io.BytesIO(content))
        probe.verify()   # structural check; does not decode pixels
    except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError, ValueError):
        logger.warning("image rejected: '%s' did not parse", label)
        raise _reject(f"'{label}' is not a valid image")

    # verify() leaves the handle in an unusable state — reopen for real use.
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(content))
    if img.width > MAX_DIMENSION or img.height > MAX_DIMENSION:
        raise _reject(
            f"'{label}' exceeds {MAX_DIMENSION}px (got {img.width}x{img.height})"
        )

    # Re-encode as PNG RGBA. Drops metadata, normalises channels for the
    # downstream BackgroundRemover which expects RGB/RGBA input.
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.convert("RGBA").save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=False)
    return buf.getvalue()

def create_media_token(patent_id: int, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None) -> str:
    """A short-lived, read-only capability token for one patent's media. Encoded

def verify_media_token(token: str, patent_id: int) -> bool:
    """True if `token` is a valid, unexpired media token for exactly this patent."""
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.jwt_secret_key, algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm])
    except JWTError:
        return False
    return payload.get("scope") == MEDIA_TOKEN_SCOPE and payload.get("pid") == patent_id

def validate_zip_upload(content: bytes, filename: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Full security validation of an uploaded ZIP file.

    Returns:
        (model_extension, model_path_in_zip) e.g. (".obj", "subfolder/model.obj")

    Raises:
        HTTPException(422) on any validation failure.
        HTTPException(413) if file exceeds size limit.
    """
    if len(content) > MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            detail="File exceeds 500 MB limit.",
        )

    ext = os.path.splitext(filename)[1].lower()
    if ext != ".zip":
        raise _reject("Only .zip files are accepted.")

    # -- Zip bomb detection (overlapping entries) --
    buf = io.BytesIO(content)
    result = has_overlapping_entries(buf)
    if result is True:
        logger.warning("ZIP rejected: overlapping entries detected (zip bomb)")
        raise _reject("ZIP file failed security scan.")
    if result is None:
        logger.warning("ZIP rejected: could not parse structure (invalid/unsupported)")
        raise _reject("Invalid or corrupted ZIP file.")

    buf.seek(0)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(buf) as z:
            members = z.infolist()

            # -- Entry count limit --
            if len(members) > MAX_ENTRY_COUNT:
                logger.warning("ZIP rejected: %d entries exceeds limit of %d", len(members), MAX_ENTRY_COUNT)
                raise _reject(f"ZIP contains too many files (maximum {MAX_ENTRY_COUNT}).")

            total_uncompressed = 0
            for info in members:
                # Symlink check
                if stat.S_ISLNK(info.external_attr >> 16):
                    logger.warning("ZIP rejected: symlink entry '%s'", info.filename)
                    raise _reject("ZIP contains symbolic links.")

                # Path traversal check
                if ".." in info.filename or info.filename.startswith("/"):
                    logger.warning("ZIP rejected: path traversal in entry '%s'", info.filename)
                    raise _reject("ZIP contains path traversal attack.")

                # Filename character check (rejects shell metacharacters)
                if not _SAFE_FILENAME_RE.match(info.filename.rstrip("/")):
                    logger.warning("ZIP rejected: unsafe characters in entry '%s'", info.filename)
                    raise _reject("ZIP contains filenames with invalid characters.")

                # Per-file size check
                if info.file_size > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                    logger.warning("ZIP rejected: entry '%s' size %d exceeds limit", info.filename, info.file_size)
                    raise _reject(f"ZIP contains a file exceeding {MAX_FILE_SIZE // (1024 * 1024)} MB.")

                total_uncompressed += info.file_size

            # Total uncompressed size check
            if total_uncompressed > MAX_EXTRACTED_SIZE:
                logger.warning("ZIP rejected: total uncompressed %d exceeds limit", total_uncompressed)
                raise _reject(f"Total uncompressed size exceeds {MAX_EXTRACTED_SIZE // (1024 * 1024)} MB.")

            # Compression ratio check
            compressed_size = len(content)
            if compressed_size > 0 and total_uncompressed / compressed_size > MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO:
                logger.warning(
                    "ZIP rejected: compression ratio %.1f exceeds limit %.1f",
                    total_uncompressed / compressed_size, MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO,
                )
                raise _reject("ZIP file failed security scan.")

            # -- Model file identification --
            found_ext: str | None = None
            found_path: str | None = None
            mtl_files: list[str] = []

            for name in z.namelist():
                if name.endswith("/"):
                    continue
                file_ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower()
                if file_ext in MODEL_EXTENSIONS:
                    if found_ext is not None:
                        raise _reject("ZIP must contain exactly one 3-D model file.")
                    found_ext = file_ext
                    found_path = name
                elif file_ext == ".mtl":
                    mtl_files.append(name)

            if found_ext is None:
                raise _reject("ZIP must contain a supported model file (.obj .stl .stp .iges .glb .fbx).")

            if found_ext == ".obj" and len(mtl_files) != 1:
                raise _reject("OBJ uploads must include exactly one .mtl file.")

            # -- MIME type validation on the model file (whitelist) --
            with z.open(found_path) as model_file:
                header = model_file.read(2048)
                mime_type = magic.from_buffer(header, mime=True)
                if mime_type not in ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES:
                    logger.warning(
                        "ZIP rejected: model file '%s' has disallowed MIME type '%s'",
                        found_path, mime_type,
                    )
                    raise _reject(f"File content does not match expected model format (detected: {mime_type}).")

        return found_ext, found_path

    except zipfile.BadZipFile:
        raise _reject("Invalid or corrupted ZIP file.")

def has_overlapping_entries(zip_file):
    """Check if a ZIP file has overlapping records (zip bomb indicator).

    Args:
        zip_file: A seekable file-like object opened in binary mode.

    Returns:
        True if overlapping records detected (likely zip bomb).
        False if no overlaps (good zip file).
        None if not a valid zip file or unsupported format.
    """
    ends = []

    zip_file.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
    size = zip_file.tell()

    def is_end(rec, pos):
        nonlocal ends
        end = struct.unpack('<HHHHLLH', rec)
        if end[0] != 0 or end[1] != 0 or pos + 22 + end[6] > size:
            return False
        ends.append((pos, pos + 22 + end[6]))
        end = end[2:6]
        if end[0] == 0xffff or end[1] == 0xffff or \
           end[2] == 0xffffffff or end[3] == 0xffffffff:
            if pos < 20:
                return False
            zip_file.seek(pos - 20, os.SEEK_SET)
            loc = struct.unpack('<LLQL', zip_file.read(20))
            if loc[0] != 0x07064b50 or loc[1] != 0 or loc[3] != 1 or \
               loc[2] + 56 > size:
                return False
            ends.append((pos - 20, pos))
            zip_file.seek(loc[2], os.SEEK_SET)
            end = struct.unpack('<LQHHLLQQQQ', zip_file.read(56))
            if end[0] != 0x06064b50 or end[1] < 44 or end[4] != 0 or \
               end[5] != 0:
                return False
            ends.append((loc[2], loc[2] + 12 + end[1]))
            end = end[6:10]
        if end[0] != end[1] or end[3] + end[2] > size:
            return False
        ends.append((end[3], end[3] + end[2]))
        ends.reverse()
        return end[1:]

    def central():
        block = 8192
        beg = size
        back = 22
        buf = b''
        i = 1
        while True:
            beg -= back
            if beg < 0:
                return False
            zip_file.seek(beg, os.SEEK_SET)
            buf = zip_file.read(back) + buf[:21]
            while i > 0:
                i -= 1
                if buf[i] == 0x50 and buf[i + 1] == 0x4b and \
                   buf[i + 2] == 5 and buf[i + 3] == 6:
                    end = is_end(buf[i + 4:i + 22], beg + i)
                    if end:
                        return end
            back = ((beg - 1) & (block - 1)) + 1
            i = back

    dir_info = central()
    if not dir_info:
        return None

    spans = []
    (num, end, pos) = dir_info
    zip_file.seek(pos, os.SEEK_SET)
    cent = zip_file.read(end)
    i = 0
    while num > 0:
        if i + 46 > end:
            break
        head = struct.unpack('<LHHHHHHLLLHHHHHLL', cent[i:i + 46])
        i += 46
        if head[0] != 0x02014b50:
            break
        skip = head[10] + head[11] + head[12]
        if i + skip > end:
            break
        clen = head[8]
        ulen = head[9]
        disk = head[13]
        off = head[16]
        if clen == 0xffffffff or ulen == 0xffffffff or \
           disk == 0xffff or off == 0xffffffff:
            good = False
            i += head[10]
            xend = i + head[11]
            while i + 4 <= xend:
                (id, data) = struct.unpack('<HH', cent[i:i + 4])
                i += 4
                if i + data > xend:
                    break
                dend = i + data
                if id == 1:
                    if ulen == 0xffffffff:
                        if i + 8 > dend:
                            break
                        ulen = struct.unpack('<Q', cent[i:i + 8])[0]
                        i += 8
                    if clen == 0xffffffff:
                        if i + 8 > dend:
                            break
                        clen = struct.unpack('<Q', cent[i:i + 8])[0]
                        i += 8
                    if off == 0xffffffff:
                        if i + 8 > dend:
                            break
                        off = struct.unpack('<Q', cent[i:i + 8])[0]
                        i += 8
                    if disk == 0xffff:
                        if i + 4 > dend:
                            break
                        disk = struct.unpack('<L', cent[i:i + 4])[0]
                        i += 4
                    if i != dend:
                        break
                    good = True
                    break
                else:
                    i = dend
            if not good:
                break
            i = xend + head[12]
        else:
            i += skip
        if disk != 0:
            break
        if off + 30 > size:
            break
        zip_file.seek(off, os.SEEK_SET)
        local = struct.unpack('<LHHHHHLLLHH', zip_file.read(30))
        if local[0] != 0x04034b50:
            break
        lend = off + 30 + local[9] + local[10] + clen
        if lend > size:
            break
        if local[2] & 8 != 0:
            crc = head[7]
            zip_file.seek(lend, os.SEEK_SET)
            desc = zip_file.read(24)
            d24 = struct.unpack('<LLQQ', desc[:24]) if len(desc) == 24 else ()
            d20 = struct.unpack('<LQQ', desc[:20]) if len(desc) >= 20 else ()
            d16 = struct.unpack('<LLLL', desc[:16]) if len(desc) >= 16 else ()
            d12 = struct.unpack('<LLL', desc[:12]) if len(desc) >= 12 else ()
            if len(desc) == 24 and d24[0] == 0x08074b50 and \
               d24[1] == crc and d24[2] == clen and d24[3] == ulen:
                lend += 24
            elif len(desc) >= 20 and \
                 d20[0] == crc and d20[1] == clen and d20[2] == ulen:
                lend += 20
            elif len(desc) >= 16 and d16[0] == 0x08074b50 and \
                 d16[1] == crc and d16[2] == clen and d16[3] == ulen:
                lend += 16
            elif len(desc) >= 12 and \
                 d12[0] == crc and d12[1] == clen and d12[2] == ulen:
                lend += 12
            else:
                break
        spans.append((off, lend))
        num -= 1
    else:
        if i == end:
            spans += ends
            spans.sort()
            this = spans[0]
            for next_span in spans[1:]:
                if this[1] > next_span[0]:
                    return True
                this = next_span
            return False

    return None

def effective_review_state(reviews: Iterable["DesignReview"]) -> ReviewState:
    """Derive a patent's moderation state from its review rows.

    APPROVED is terminal, so a single approved cycle wins outright. Otherwise the
    latest cycle decides: PENDING -> UNDER_REVIEW, REJECTED -> REJECTED, and no
    rows at all -> DRAFT."""
    rows = list(reviews)
    if any(r.status == ReviewDecision.APPROVED for r in rows):
        return ReviewState.APPROVED
    latest = latest_review(rows)
    if latest is None:
        return ReviewState.DRAFT
    if latest.status == ReviewDecision.PENDING:
        return ReviewState.UNDER_REVIEW
    if latest.status == ReviewDecision.REJECTED:
        return ReviewState.REJECTED
    return ReviewState.DRAFT

Admin Locarno tree management: add / rename / reorder / delete main classes and subclasses. Gated at the package router level.

Two invariants enforced here, since the DB does NOT protect them: * Designs reference Locarno entries by plain string (patents_patent.locarno_*) with no foreign key. So before deleting any entry we count designs that reference it and refuse (409) if any do — never orphan a design's classification. * Deleting a main class cascades to its subclasses, but only after the in-use check covers the main value AND every child subclass value.

Apply the admin's complete desired tree in one transaction: inserts, label/number edits, and reordering by list position, plus deletes for any entry the payload drops. Entry identity is value. Deletes are refused (409) if any design still references the removed main/subclass — the whole save is rejected, never partially applied.

Subclasses cannot be moved between main classes here (the editor never produces that), so a subclass changing parents is rejected (422) rather than silently repointed.

@router.put("/tree", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
async def save_tree(body: LocarnoTreeUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    """Apply the admin's complete desired tree in one transaction: inserts,
    label/number edits, and reordering by list position, plus deletes for any
    entry the payload drops. Entry identity is `value`. Deletes are refused
    (409) if any design still references the removed main/subclass — the whole
    save is rejected, never partially applied.

    Subclasses cannot be moved between main classes here (the editor never
    produces that), so a subclass changing parents is rejected (422) rather
    than silently repointed."""
    # 1. Validate payload self-consistency.
    main_values = [m.value for m in body.main_classes]
    if len(main_values) != len(set(main_values)):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Duplicate main class value in payload.")
    numbers = [m.number for m in body.main_classes]
    if len(numbers) != len(set(numbers)):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Duplicate main class number in payload.")

    desired_sub_parent: dict[str, str] = {}
    for m in body.main_classes:
        for s in m.subclasses:
            if s.value in desired_sub_parent:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    f"Subclass {s.value!r} appears more than once.",
                )
            desired_sub_parent[s.value] = m.value

    # 2. Load current state.
    cur_mains = {r.value: r for r in (await db.execute(select(LocarnoMainClassRow))).scalars().all()}
    cur_subs = {r.value: r for r in (await db.execute(select(LocarnoSubclassRow))).scalars().all()}

    # Reject parent moves (identity is value; a sub must stay under its main).
    for sub_value, parent in desired_sub_parent.items():
        existing = cur_subs.get(sub_value)
        if existing is not None and existing.main_class_value != parent:
            raise HTTPException(
                status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                f"Subclass {sub_value!r} cannot be moved to a different main class.",
            )

    # 3. Compute deletes and refuse if any are still referenced by a design.
    desired_main_set = set(main_values)
    desired_sub_set = set(desired_sub_parent)
    mains_to_delete = [v for v in cur_mains if v not in desired_main_set]
    subs_to_delete = [v for v in cur_subs if v not in desired_sub_set]

    blocked: list[str] = []
    if mains_to_delete:
        rows = (
            await db.execute(
                select(Patent.locarno_main_class, func.count())
                .where(Patent.locarno_main_class.in_(mains_to_delete))
                .group_by(Patent.locarno_main_class)
            )
        ).all()
        blocked += [f"main class {v} ({n} design(s))" for v, n in rows]
    if subs_to_delete:
        rows = (
            await db.execute(
                select(Patent.locarno_subclass, func.count())
                .where(Patent.locarno_subclass.in_(subs_to_delete))
                .group_by(Patent.locarno_subclass)
            )
        ).all()
        blocked += [f"subclass {v} ({n} design(s))" for v, n in rows]
    if blocked:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            "Cannot save. The following entries are still referenced by designs: "
            + "; ".join(blocked) + ". Reclassify those designs first.",
        )

    # 4. Apply. Delete first (frees unique `number`s), then create, then update.
    try:
        for v in subs_to_delete:
            await db.delete(cur_subs[v])
        await db.flush()
        for v in mains_to_delete:  # subclasses already gone, so RESTRICT FK is satisfied
            await db.delete(cur_mains[v])
        await db.flush()

        for m_index, m in enumerate(body.main_classes):
            main_row = cur_mains.get(m.value)
            if main_row is None:
                main_row = LocarnoMainClassRow(value=m.value, number=m.number, label=m.label, sort_index=m_index)
                db.add(main_row)
            else:
                main_row.number = m.number
                main_row.label = m.label
                main_row.sort_index = m_index
            await db.flush()  # ensure the main exists before its subclasses reference it

            for s_index, s in enumerate(m.subclasses):
                sub_row = cur_subs.get(s.value)
                if sub_row is None:
                    db.add(LocarnoSubclassRow(
                        value=s.value, main_class_value=m.value, label=s.label,
                        locarno_id=s.locarno_id, sort_index=s_index,
                    ))
                else:
                    sub_row.label = s.label
                    sub_row.sort_index = s_index
                    if s.locarno_id is not None:  # never clear an existing id on edit
                        sub_row.locarno_id = s.locarno_id

        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError:
        await db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            "Save failed a uniqueness check. Most likely a main class number "
            "is already taken. Check the numbers and try again.",
        )
    locarno_cache.invalidate()
    return {
        "main_classes": len(body.main_classes),
        "subclasses": len(desired_sub_parent),
        "deleted_main_classes": len(mains_to_delete),
        "deleted_subclasses": len(subs_to_delete),
    }

async def get_optional_user(
    token: str | None = Depends(oauth2_scheme_optional),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
) -> User | None:
    """Resolve the current user when a valid token is present, else return None.

    Never raises on a missing/invalid token — callers decide what an anonymous
    request may see. Used by the public media routes so they can grant an owner
    or expert access to a not-yet-public design while still serving approved
    designs to everyone."""
    if not token:
        return None
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.jwt_secret_key, algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm])
        sub: str | None = payload.get("sub")
        if sub is None:
            return None
        user_id = int(sub)
    except (JWTError, ValueError):
        return None
    return await db.get(User, user_id)

@router.get("", response_model=list[ExpertSubmissionItem])
async def list_pending_submissions(
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    q: str | None = Query(None, description="Fuzzy name search (typo-tolerant via pg_trgm)."),
    locarno_main: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by Locarno main class value."),
    locarno_subclass: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by Locarno subclass value."),
    limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
):
    """The shared queue of submissions awaiting evaluation, oldest first.

    A design is awaiting evaluation when it has a PENDING review (approval is
    terminal, so an APPROVED review can never coexist with a PENDING one).
    Filterable by Locarno classification and by fuzzy name, like the catalog."""
    stmt = (
        select(Patent, DesignReview.submitted_at)
        .join(DesignReview, DesignReview.patent_id == Patent.id)
        .where(DesignReview.status == ReviewDecision.PENDING)
        .options(selectinload(Patent.user), selectinload(Patent.reviews))
    )

    if locarno_main:
        stmt = stmt.where(Patent.locarno_main_class == locarno_main)
    if locarno_subclass:
        stmt = stmt.where(Patent.locarno_subclass == locarno_subclass)

    q_clean = q.strip() if q else None
    if q_clean:
        await db.execute(text("SET LOCAL pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold = 0.3"))
        stmt = stmt.where(Patent.model_filename.op("%>")(q_clean))
        stmt = stmt.order_by(
            func.word_similarity(q_clean, Patent.model_filename).desc(),
            DesignReview.submitted_at.asc(),
        )
    else:
        stmt = stmt.order_by(DesignReview.submitted_at.asc())

    stmt = stmt.limit(limit).offset(offset)
    rows = (await db.execute(stmt)).all()

    return [_expert_item(patent, submitted_at) for patent, submitted_at in rows]

def delete_patent_files(patent: Patent) -> None:
    """Remove a patent's on-disk artifacts without touching anything else.

    The converted GLB and (for image-gen) the source images each live in their
    own per-patent directory, so we remove those directories whole. The uploaded
    ZIP, however, is a lone file inside the shared `uploads/user_X/` directory
    that also holds the user's other ZIPs — so we delete just that file, never
    its parent. Same for an optional thumbnail. Shared by the owner delete and
    the admin delete.
    """
    media_root = settings.media_root

    # Per-patent directories — safe to remove whole.
    if patent.glb_file_path:
        glb_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.join(media_root, patent.glb_file_path))

@router.post(
    "/generate",
    response_model=PatentUploadResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
)
async def generate_from_images(
    front: UploadFile = File(..., description="Front view (required)"),
    left: UploadFile | None = File(None, description="Left view (optional)"),
    right: UploadFile | None = File(None, description="Right view (optional)"),
    back: UploadFile | None = File(None, description="Back view (optional)"),
    title: str | None = Form(None, description="Optional name for the generated model"),
    locarno_main_class: str = Form(...),
    locarno_subclass: str = Form(...),
    quality: str | None = Form(None, description="Quality preset: turbo|fast|standard"),
    detail: str | None = Form(None, description="Detail preset: low|standard|high"),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
):
    """
    Upload 1-4 view images under a Locarno classification. Validated, re-encoded
    to PNG, stored, and handed off to the `generate` Celery queue which routes to
    the host-native Hunyuan3D service. Returns 202 with QUEUED status; poll
    /status or /list for progress (QUEUED → GENERATING → QUEUED → CONVERTING →
    CONVERTED).

    The Hunyuan3D-2mv model was trained on front/left/back — 'right' is
    accepted but may be ignored or degrade quality.
    """
    # Same Locarno gate as the ZIP-upload path so every registered design,
    # however it was produced, carries a valid classification.
    await locarno_cache.validate_pair(db, locarno_main_class, locarno_subclass)

    # Resolve presets up-front so we fail fast on bad input.
    overrides: dict = {}
    if quality is not None:
        if quality not in QUALITY_PRESETS:
            raise HTTPException(
                status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                f"quality must be one of {list(QUALITY_PRESETS)}",
            )
        overrides["num_inference_steps"] = QUALITY_PRESETS[quality]
    if detail is not None:
        if detail not in DETAIL_PRESETS:
            raise HTTPException(
                status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                f"detail must be one of {list(DETAIL_PRESETS)}",
            )
        overrides["octree_resolution"] = DETAIL_PRESETS[detail]

    uploads_by_view = {"front": front, "left": left, "right": right, "back": back}
    uploads_by_view = {k: v for k, v in uploads_by_view.items() if v is not None}

    # Validate + re-encode each view up-front so we fail before writing anything.
    validated: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    for view_name, upload in uploads_by_view.items():
        if upload.content_type not in IMAGE_ALLOWED_MIMES:
            raise HTTPException(
                status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                f"'{view_name}' must be PNG, JPEG, or WebP (got {upload.content_type}).",
            )
        content = await upload.read()
        validated[view_name] = validate_and_reencode(content, view_name)

    # Persist to disk
    timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    stem_raw = title.strip() if title else f"generated_{timestamp}"
    stem = _sanitize_filename(stem_raw) or f"generated_{timestamp}"
    storage_rel = f"uploads/user_{current_user.id}/{timestamp}_image_gen_{stem}"
    storage_abs = os.path.join(settings.media_root, storage_rel)
    os.makedirs(storage_abs, exist_ok=True)

    related: dict[str, str] = {}
    for view_name, png_bytes in validated.items():
        filename = f"{view_name}.png"
        with open(os.path.join(storage_abs, filename), "wb") as f:
            f.write(png_bytes)
        related[view_name] = filename

    # Create the Patent row as QUEUED — generation is dispatched immediately
    # (unlike the ZIP flow where the user manually triggers convert), but the
    # worker flips it to GENERATING when it actually picks the task up.
    patent = Patent(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        file_type=FileType.IMAGE,
        model_filename=stem,
        locarno_main_class=locarno_main_class,
        locarno_subclass=locarno_subclass,
        storage_path=storage_rel,
        related_files=related,
        conversion_status=ConversionStatus.QUEUED,
    )
    db.add(patent)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(patent)

    generate_from_image_task.delay(patent.id, overrides or None)

    return PatentUploadResponse(
        patent_id=patent.id,
        status=patent.conversion_status,
        message=f"Generation started with {len(validated)} view(s).",
    )

@router.get("/", response_model=list[PatentListItem])
async def list_patents(
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    q: str | None = Query(None, description="Fuzzy name search (typo-tolerant via pg_trgm)."),
    locarno_main: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by Locarno main class value."),
    locarno_subclass: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by Locarno subclass value."),
    limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
):
    """Browse the design catalog.

    Public endpoint (no auth) so anonymous visitors can see the catalog.
    Per-row owner-only actions (convert/delete) live behind their own auth-gated
    routes; this list only exposes data that's already viewable via the public
    /model endpoint.

    With `q` set, results are ordered by trigram similarity (best matches first)
    and filtered to rows whose `model_filename` is similar enough to `q`
    (pg_trgm `%` operator at the session's similarity threshold).

    Only APPROVED designs appear here: a design is public once an expert has
    approved it (it has an APPROVED review row). Drafts, under-review, and
    rejected designs are excluded.
    """
    # Public gate: the design must have an APPROVED review.
    stmt = (
        select(Patent)
        .where(Patent.reviews.any(DesignReview.status == ReviewDecision.APPROVED))
        .options(selectinload(Patent.user))
    )

    if locarno_main:
        stmt = stmt.where(Patent.locarno_main_class == locarno_main)
    if locarno_subclass:
        stmt = stmt.where(Patent.locarno_subclass == locarno_subclass)

    q_clean = q.strip() if q else None
    if q_clean:
        # Use word_similarity (not plain similarity) so long names like
        # "subway_train_interior" aren't penalized for their length —
        # word_similarity scores against the best matching window of the
        # target string and respects non-alphanumeric word boundaries.
        # SET LOCAL is scoped to this transaction only.
        await db.execute(text("SET LOCAL pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold = 0.3"))
        stmt = stmt.where(Patent.model_filename.op("%>")(q_clean))
        stmt = stmt.order_by(
            func.word_similarity(q_clean, Patent.model_filename).desc(),
            Patent.uploaded_at.desc(),
        )
    else:
        stmt = stmt.order_by(Patent.uploaded_at.desc())

    stmt = stmt.limit(limit).offset(offset)

    patents = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()

    # Every row here is approved by construction.
    return [_patent_list_item(p, review_state=ReviewState.APPROVED) for p in patents]

@router.get("/mine", response_model=list[MySubmissionItem])
async def list_my_submissions(
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
):
    """The signed-in user's own submissions across every state.

    This is how an owner manages drafts, sees rejection reasons, and tracks
    approvals - the public catalog only shows approved designs. UNDER_REVIEW
    items are returned obscured (descriptive fields nulled): during evaluation
    the registration is hidden even from its owner."""
    stmt = (
        select(Patent)
        .where(Patent.user_id == current_user.id)
        .options(selectinload(Patent.reviews))
        .order_by(Patent.uploaded_at.desc())
    )
    patents = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()

    items: list[MySubmissionItem] = []
    for p in patents:
        state = effective_review_state(p.reviews)
        latest = latest_review(p.reviews)
        if state == ReviewState.UNDER_REVIEW:
            # Obscured: expose only that it exists and is under review.
            items.append(MySubmissionItem(
                id=p.id,
                review_state=state,
                submitted_at=latest.submitted_at if latest else None,
            ))
            continue
        items.append(MySubmissionItem(
            id=p.id,
            review_state=state,
            submitted_at=latest.submitted_at if latest else None,
            rejection_reason=_latest_rejection_reason(p),
            model_filename=p.model_filename,

            conversion_status=p.conversion_status,

Fetch a single patent's catalog metadata for its detail page.

Visibility follows the review state: - APPROVED designs are public (anonymous visitors and QR scans included). - Admins and experts may open a design in any state. - DRAFT / REJECTED designs are also visible to their owner (so they can preview and manage them). - UNDER_REVIEW designs are obscured from their owner (403); only admins and experts may open them. Anything else returns 404 so non-public designs aren't enumerable.

@router.get("/{patent_id}", response_model=PatentListItem)
async def get_patent(
    patent_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
):
    """Fetch a single patent's catalog metadata for its detail page.

    Visibility follows the review state:
    - APPROVED designs are public (anonymous visitors and QR scans included).
    - Admins and experts may open a design in any state.
    - DRAFT / REJECTED designs are also visible to their owner (so they can
      preview and manage them).
    - UNDER_REVIEW designs are obscured from their owner (403); only admins and
      experts may open them.
    Anything else returns 404 so non-public designs aren't enumerable.
    """
    stmt = (
        select(Patent)
        .where(Patent.id == patent_id)
        .options(selectinload(Patent.user), selectinload(Patent.reviews))
    )
    patent = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not patent:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Patent not found.")

    state = effective_review_state(patent.reviews)
    if state == ReviewState.APPROVED:
        # Public: the plain /model URL already works, no capability token needed.
        return _patent_list_item(patent, review_state=state)

    # A signed, short-lived token so the QR link to a not-yet-public model
    # resolves for an unauthenticated scanner. Only minted once converted.
    media_token = (
        create_media_token(patent.id)
        if patent.conversion_status == ConversionStatus.CONVERTED
        else None
    )

    # Admins and experts can see everything.
    if user is not None and user.role in (UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.EXPERT):
        return _patent_list_item(
            patent, review_state=state,
            rejection_reason=_latest_rejection_reason(patent), model_token=media_token,
        )

    is_owner = user is not None and user.id == patent.user_id
    if is_owner:
        if state == ReviewState.UNDER_REVIEW:
            # Obscured even from the owner during evaluation.
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "This registration is under evaluation.")
        return _patent_list_item(
            patent, review_state=state,
            rejection_reason=_latest_rejection_reason(patent), model_token=media_token,
        )

    raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Patent not found.")

@router.get("/{patent_id}/model")
async def serve_model(
    patent_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
    token: str | None = Query(None, description="Signed media token (used by QR links)."),
):
    """Stream the converted GLB file.

    Public for APPROVED designs (so QR-code scans work without a token); for
    other states only the owner (DRAFT/REJECTED), experts, admins, or a holder
    of a valid signed media token may fetch it. The token lets an owner preview
    a draft in AR by scanning its QR. See _can_view_media / verify_media_token."""
    stmt = (
        select(Patent)
        .where(Patent.id == patent_id)
        .options(selectinload(Patent.reviews))
    )
    patent = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
    has_access = patent is not None and (
        _can_view_media(patent, user) or (token is not None and verify_media_token(token, patent.id))
    )
    if not has_access:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Patent not found.")

    if patent.conversion_status != ConversionStatus.CONVERTED:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            f"Model not ready. Current status: {patent.conversion_status}",
        )

    glb_abs = os.path.join(settings.media_root, patent.glb_file_path)
    if not os.path.exists(glb_abs):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "GLB file missing from storage.")

    return FileResponse(
        glb_abs,
        media_type="model/gltf-binary",
        filename=f"{patent.model_filename}.glb",
    )

@router.get("/{patent_id}/thumbnail")
async def serve_thumbnail(
    patent_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
):
    """Stream the PNG thumbnail. Public for APPROVED designs (like /model) so the
    browse grid and QR-scanned clients can show a preview; otherwise restricted
    to the owner/expert/admin (see _can_view_media). 404 when the patent never
    produced a thumbnail (the render is best-effort) — callers fall back."""

        .where(Patent.id == patent_id)
        .options(selectinload(Patent.reviews))
    )
    patent = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not patent or not patent.thumbnail_path or not _can_view_media(patent, user):

    if not os.path.exists(thumb_abs):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Thumbnail missing from storage.")

    return FileResponse(thumb_abs, media_type="image/png")

@router.get("/{patent_id}/images/{view}")
async def serve_source_image(
    patent_id: int,
    view: str,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
):
    """Stream one of the reference photos an image-gen design was built from.

    Public for APPROVED designs so the detail page can show source views;
    otherwise restricted to the owner/expert/admin (see _can_view_media). `view`
    is a label from the patent's related_files map (front/left/right/back). 404
    for ZIP uploads or unknown views."""
    stmt = (
        select(Patent)
        .where(Patent.id == patent_id)
        .options(selectinload(Patent.reviews))
    )
    patent = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if (
        not patent
        or patent.file_type != FileType.IMAGE
        or not patent.storage_path
        or not isinstance(patent.related_files, dict)
        or not _can_view_media(patent, user)
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Source image not found.")

    filename = patent.related_files.get(view)
    if not filename:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Source image not found.")

    img_abs = os.path.join(settings.media_root, patent.storage_path, filename)
    if not os.path.exists(img_abs):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Source image missing from storage.")

    return FileResponse(img_abs, media_type="image/png")

@router.delete("/{patent_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_patent(
    patent_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
):
    """Delete a patent record and its files from disk.

    Blocked while the registration is UNDER_REVIEW (it's locked during
    evaluation). Admins can still delete any design via the admin route."""
    patent = await _get_owned_patent(patent_id, current_user, db)

    if effective_review_state(patent.reviews) == ReviewState.UNDER_REVIEW:
        raise HTTPException(
            status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            "This registration is locked while under evaluation.",
        )

    delete_patent_files(patent)

    await db.delete(patent)
    await db.commit()

docs.title: app.worker.tasks
docs.text:
Celery tasks for 3D model conversion and generation.

Two independent flows:

convert_patent_task (queue: convert, concurrency=1) Takes an uploaded ZIP, runs it through the ephemeral youndria/arpatent:1.2 container via DooD, produces a GLB. See convert_patent_task docstring.

generate_from_image_task (queue: generate, concurrency=1) Takes one-or-more view images already on the media volume, posts them to the host-native Hunyuan3D API server, writes the returned GLB back to the media volume. Serialized at the queue level because a single GPU cannot run two generations in parallel.

generate_thumbnail_task(self, patent_id: int) -> None

Render a PNG thumbnail of a patent's converted GLB, then flip it to CONVERTED.

Enqueued by convert_patent_task once the GLB is on disk. Both the upload and the image-generation pipelines funnel through that task, so this single hook covers both ingestion paths.

Thumbnailing is best-effort: we try exactly once (max_retries=0) and the patent becomes available (CONVERTED) whether or not the render succeeds — a missing thumbnail must never gate an otherwise-finished model. The render runs in the same hardened, network-less converter container as conversion.

@celery_app.task(bind=True, max_retries=0, name="generate_thumbnail")
def generate_thumbnail_task(self, patent_id: int) -> None:
    """Render a PNG thumbnail of a patent's converted GLB, then flip it to
    CONVERTED.

    Enqueued by convert_patent_task once the GLB is on disk. Both the upload and
    the image-generation pipelines funnel through that task, so this single hook
    covers both ingestion paths.

    Thumbnailing is best-effort: we try exactly once (max_retries=0) and the
    patent becomes available (CONVERTED) whether or not the render succeeds — a
    missing thumbnail must never gate an otherwise-finished model. The render
    runs in the same hardened, network-less converter container as conversion.
    """
    db = SyncSessionLocal()
    patent: Patent | None = None
    container_name = f"thumbnailer-{patent_id}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    try:
        patent = db.get(Patent, patent_id)
        if not patent:
            logger.error("generate_thumbnail_task: patent %d not found", patent_id)
            return
        if not patent.glb_file_path:
            raise RuntimeError("patent has no glb_file_path to thumbnail")

        glb_abs = os.path.join(settings.media_root, patent.glb_file_path)
        if not os.path.exists(glb_abs):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"GLB missing at {glb_abs}")

        # Thumbnail lives next to the GLB so delete_patent_files' glb-dir sweep
        # cleans it up for free.
        thumb_rel = f"{os.path.dirname(patent.glb_file_path)}/thumbnail.png"
        thumb_abs = os.path.join(settings.media_root, thumb_rel)

        create_cmd = _converter_create_cmd(
            container_name, THUMBNAIL_SCRIPT,
            ["/tmp/model.glb", "/output/thumbnail.png"],
        )
        logger.info("Creating thumbnailer container %s for patent %d",
                    container_name, patent_id)
        _docker(create_cmd, check=True)

        # Copy in the GLB plus the renderer script (the image has neither).
        _docker(["docker", "cp", glb_abs, f"{container_name}:/tmp/model.glb"],
                check=True)
        _docker(["docker", "cp", _THUMBNAIL_SCRIPT_PATH,
                 f"{container_name}:/tmp/thumbnail.py"], check=True)

        result = _docker(
            ["docker", "start", "-a", container_name], timeout=CONTAINER_TIMEOUT,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Thumbnailer exited {result.returncode}.\n"
                f"stdout: {result.stdout[-1000:]}\n"
                f"stderr: {result.stderr[-1000:]}"
            )

        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(thumb_abs), exist_ok=True)
        _docker(
            ["docker", "cp", f"{container_name}:/output/thumbnail.png", thumb_abs],
            check=True,
        )
        if not os.path.exists(thumb_abs):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Expected thumbnail not found at {thumb_abs}")

        patent.thumbnail_path = thumb_rel
        logger.info("Patent %d thumbnail rendered -> %s", patent_id, thumb_rel)

    except Exception:
        # Best-effort: log and fall through. The finally block still flips the
        # patent to CONVERTED so a thumbnail failure never blocks the model.
        logger.exception(
            "Thumbnail render failed for patent %d; making it available without one",
            patent_id,
        )
    finally:
        if patent:
            patent.conversion_status = ConversionStatus.CONVERTED
            db.commit()
        _docker(["docker", "rm", "-f", container_name])
        db.close()

generate_from_image_task(self, patent_id: int, gen_overrides: dict | None = None) -> None

Generate a GLB from one-or-more view images via the host-native Hunyuan3D API server. Uses /generate (sync) so errors surface immediately as HTTP 404 with a descriptive body — /send swallows worker-thread errors silently.

Preconditions on the Patent row
  • file_type == IMAGE
  • storage_path points to the directory containing the view images
  • related_files is a dict mapping view label -> filename (e.g. {"front": "front.png", "left": "left.png"})

gen_overrides is an optional dict merged on top of GEN_DEFAULTS — used by the /generate endpoint to plumb UI presets (quality, detail) into pipeline params (num_inference_steps, octree_resolution).
